text: THE DOORS OPEN: you step into the dark halls.
DRUMS IN THE DEEP: the DEEP WARDEN comes.
THE FLAME OF THE DEEP rises. the bridge shakes.
the lamp gutters. the halls remember every miner.
coin and ore lie in the dust. the dead miners left them.
goblins gnaw the pillars. the deep wakes.
chanters sing in the shafts. they know your name.
a rune reads: DO NOT WAKE THE TROLLS.
DRUMS: the shafts open. brace yourself.
dead dwarves stand at the gate. what do they guard?
DRUMS: more climb out of the deep well.
the warden is silent. its eyes follow your lamp.
DRUMS: bats pour from the shaft in a spiral.
your grip is steady. the deep has made you hard.
THE LAST DRUM: the whole deep comes at once.
the drums stop. something of shadow and flame walks the bridge.
